title: Monthly Air Pollution
description: Average monthly concentration of key air pollutants.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 as the data is at monthly frequency.

fields.name: concentration
fields.title: Concentration
fields.description: [Float] The concentration of the pollutant in parts per million (ppm) or micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m³). All pollutants are measured in ppm except for PM₁₀ and PM₂.₅, which are measured in µg/m³.

methodology: This dataset presents monthly concentrations of various air pollutants, including carbon monoxide (CO), nitrogen dioxide (NO²), ozone (O³), particulate matter (PM₁₀, PM₂.₅), and sulfur dioxide (SO²). The data is tabulated from hourly observational data collected from monitoring stations across Malaysia.
caveat: A small minority of values in 2017 are null due to inavailability of data.
